current.text: He has gone first overall in every expert mock draft.
The experts rank him the number one player in 9-cat head-to-head leagues and would take him first overall, ahead of Wembanyama.
He has the tightest range in round one. Best case is 1st overall and worst case is 3rd.
In an expert auction mock he went for 80 USD. The expert valued him at 73 to 74 USD.
If the room spends evenly and he sits near 55 USD, buy him. That leaves about 20 USD to spend elsewhere.
Expect about 35 minutes per game. The expert does not expect more regression in his threes, minutes or steals.
He is projected for a usage rate over 30.
Last season he had the fewest potential assists among the league's assist leaders.
His assists could drop to about 10.1 per game if his teammates' shooting evens out.
He is healthy heading into the season, and so is the rest of the Denver roster.
He missed a lot of time last season with a knee injury.
He could become a free agent. He has not been happy in Denver for two years, but the expert expects him to stay on the roster all season and re-sign.
Denver plays 43 games through March 28, one below the most of any team, and has only 14 back-to-backs, one of the lowest counts in the league.
He plays four games in the week starting March 15, which is week 20 of our playoffs.
The expert doubts Denver will rest Jokic on purpose.
The expert projects Denver to win about 50 games and expects at least two of last year's starters, including Cam Johnson, to be traded by the deadline. The team is short on spacing around him.

durable.text: He has been the best fantasy player of the last five or six years and finished number one in both category and points leagues.
He is a league outlier in FG% on high volume, points, rebounds and assists. Getting both rebounds and assists from one player is rare, and that is where his extra value comes from.
His steals are very high for a center.
He commits many turnovers. TO is his one clearly weak category.
He has no significant weakness apart from turnovers. His relative weak spots are threes, blocks and free throws, and his free throws are fine but not a big strength.
Injury history: a hamstring injury two seasons ago and a knee injury last season that was partly bad luck.
At 31 he is getting a little less durable, but the experts are not worried.
He gets more tired on defense in the middle of the season than he admits.

note: Jokić is the consensus first overall pick, but auction prices run well above formula value. Yahoo values him at 61 USD while managers pay 78.8 USD on Yahoo and 85.5 USD on ESPN, and he cost 87 USD in our league last season. Expect a winning bid of 80 to 90 USD, and only treat it as a bargain below about 75 USD, which matches the expert's 73 to 74 USD value. He helps every build except one that needs turnovers, so he fits punt TO best. Early in the season, check that he plays about 35 minutes and that his assists hold near 10 per game.
